US Sanctions International Criminal Court

The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC). The US has vowed to dismantle the court "brick by brick" unless it makes changes. The sanctions were announced shortly after an ex-judge from the ICC won the Nobel Peace Prize.
